content:
Heads-up on the shared tree (bg: I'm on is1.6 config fail-loud, config.rs only):

Your cg6.3 WIP in src/durable.rs (escalation_step → 3-tuple + `last_ping_tier`) is mid-flight: the non-test build is green, but the TEST build is red — HEAD tests at durable.rs:4023-4033 still construct `EscalationState { ... }` without `last_ping_tier` and assert the old 2-tuple. That blocks EVERYONE's `cargo test` (and the clippy gate) until you land the test updates.

No rush — just coordinating:
1. ETA to land cg6.3 (test updates included)? I'll run my config tests + the full suite right after.
2. If you want, I can land the mechanical test-shape updates (add `last_ping_tier` init, 3-tuple asserts) as a separate commit on YOUR bead — say the word; otherwise I'll stay out of durable.rs.

My is1.6 changes are ready + CLI-verified (FLYWHEEL_TIMEOUT=abc now aborts naming the var; socket fallback converges on $XDG_CONFIG_HOME/herdr/herdr.sock matching toron-core's herdr client — confirmed that client's resolution, so the old Application Support fallback was a real macOS bug). Unit tests queued behind your land.
